landing.heroSubhead: Weirwise routes your documents, pages, and notes through one controlled flow, so the assistants you publish answer from your business — with the source beside every claim.
landing.heroNote: Free to start · No credit card · Your knowledge stays in your workspace
landing.consoleHint: Choose a source to follow its path
landing.demo1Question: What's our refund window for annual plans?
landing.demo1Answer: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. After that, the plan stays active until the end of the billing period.
landing.demo2Answer: Yes. Single sign-on is available on Team and Enterprise plans, with automatic user provisioning through your identity provider.
landing.demo3Question: How do I invite a teammate?
landing.demo3Answer: Open Workspace settings, choose Members, and send an invite by email. New members join with the role you assign.
landing.demo4Question: What should a new hire do in week one?
landing.demo4Answer: Start with the welcome checklist, meet your onboarding partner, and complete the security and tools setup before your first project.
landing.pathTitle: One clear route from knowledge to answer.
landing.pathSubtitle: Nothing to wire together. Bring your material in, set the rules once, and every answer follows the same controlled path.
landing.path1Desc: Drop in PDFs, pages, and notes. Weirwise keeps them organised and ready.
landing.path2Desc: Choose what the assistant can use, how it sounds, and who it answers for.
landing.path3Desc: Every response arrives with the exact passage behind it.
landing.path4Desc: Share a link, embed it on your site, or connect it through the API.
landing.proofBody: An answer without a source is just a guess. Weirwise attaches the document, section, and passage behind every claim, so your team can verify it in one click.
landing.proofPoint1: The exact passage, not a vague reference
landing.proofPoint2: Exact search when the original wording matters
landing.proofPoint3: A clear “not in your knowledge” answer when the source isn't there

landing.control2Desc: Open the source behind an answer without leaving the conversation.
landing.control3Desc: A hosted link, an embedded widget, or your own product through the API.
